title: Newly synthesized sulfonamide derivatives explored for DNA binding, enzyme inhibitory, and cytotoxicity activities: a mixed computational and experimental analyses.
authors: Arshad, Nasima; Mehmood, Yasir; Ismail, Hammad; Perveen, Fouzia; Javed, Aneela; Channar, Pervaiz Ali; Saeed, Aamer; Naseem, Sadia; Naseer, Fatima
one_liner_zh: 该文合成磺胺衍生物并通过实验与分子对接研究其与DNA的结合及酶抑制活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和对接方法，但对象为小分子-DNA而非TF-DNA体系，深度有限。
abstract: The current research work reports the synthesis of three 4-((3-arylthiazolo[3,4-d]isoxazol-5-yl)amino)benzene sulfonamide derivatives with a thaizaole(3,4-d)isoxazole-based fused ring heterocyclic system. The synthesized and characterized derivatives, namely, 4-(3-(2-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)thiazolo[3,4-d]soxazole-5-ylamino)benzenesulfonamide (YM-1), 4-(3-(4-chlorophenyl)isoxazolo[3,4-d]thiazol-5-ylamino)benzenesulfonamide (YM-2), and 4-(3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)isoxazolo[3,4-d]thiazol-5-ylamino)benzenesulfonamide (YM-3) were further explored for their binding interactions with DNA and enzymes (urease and carbonic anhydrase). Cytotoxicity of these derivatives for both healthy (HEK-293) and cancerous (MG-U87) cells was determined by MTT analysis. Both experimental (UV-visible, fluorescence, cyclic voltammetry, and viscometry) and theoretical (molecular docking) profiles suggested that these derivatives are good DNA binders. All the derivatives interacted with DNA via mixed intercalative and groove binding interactions. However, the evaluated DNA binding parameters (K (b), DeltaG, and n) were comparatively greater for YM-1. Docking data (K (b) and DeltaG) for binding of these derivatives with enzymes also supported that YM-1 was a comparatively better inhibitor for carbonic anhydrase. However, experimentally evaluated IC(50) (1.90 +/- 0.02 muM) and % inhibition (57.93%) were found to be greater for YM-2 against urease enzyme. All the derivatives show dose-dependent cytotoxicity (70-90%) against MG-U87 cancer cells. Conversely, only one concentration of YM-1 (120 muM) showed less toxicity (50.28% with IC(50) of 1.154 +/- 0.317 muM) than that of the positive control (52.22%) for healthy cells. Overall findings suggested sulfonamide derivative YM-1 is a better candidate for DNA binding, enzyme inhibition as well as anticancer activity.
abstract_zh: 当前研究工作报道了三种含有噻唑并[3,4-d]异噁唑稠环杂环体系的4-((3-芳基噻唑并[3,4-d]异噁唑-5-基)氨基)苯磺酰胺衍生物的合成。所合成并表征的衍生物，即4-(3-(2-羟基-3-甲氧基苯基)噻唑并[3,4-d]异噁唑-5-基氨基)苯磺酰胺（YM-1）、4-(3-(4-氯苯基)异噁唑并[3,4-d]噻唑-5-基氨基)苯磺酰胺（YM-2）和4-(3-(3-羟基苯基)异噁唑并[3,4-d]噻唑-5-基氨基)苯磺酰胺（YM-3），进一步探讨了它们与DNA及酶（脲酶和碳酸酐酶）的结合相互作用。通过MTT分析测定了这些衍生物对健康细胞（HEK-293）和癌细胞（MG-U87）的细胞毒性。实验（紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱、循环伏安法和粘度法）和理论（分子对接）研究均表明，这些衍生物是良好的DNA结合剂。所有衍生物均通过混合嵌入和沟槽结合方式与DNA相互作用。然而，评估的DNA结合参数（K(b)、DeltaG和n）对YM-1相对更大。这些衍生物与酶结合的对接数据（K(b)和DeltaG）也支持YM-1是碳酸酐酶的相对更优抑制剂。然而，实验评估的IC(50)（1.90 ± 0.02 μM）和抑制率（57.93%）对YM-2针对脲酶更大。所有衍生物对MG-U87癌细胞表现出剂量依赖性细胞毒性（70-90%）。相反，仅YM-1的一个浓度（120 μM）对健康细胞显示出低于阳性对照（52.22%）的较低毒性（50.28%，IC(50)为1.154 ± 0.317 μM）。总体结果表明，磺酰胺衍生物YM-1是DNA结合、酶抑制及抗癌活性的更优候选物。
